w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: "Stonebridge is eating bark and calling it dinner," Grace says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Grace Larsen, Felix Fischer, Ruth Weber. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/11/7), with 6 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 6 · Craft 10 · Talk 15 · Explore 38 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,428 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
